+"""Script to prepare a new release."""
+
+import sys
+import re
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/release.py <version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    new_version = sys.argv[1]
+    
+    # 1. Update fastapi/__init__.py
+    init_file = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    if not re.search(r'__version__ = "[^"]+"', content):
+        print(f"Could not find __version__ in {init_file}")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    content = re.sub(r'__version__ = "[^"]+"', f'__version__ = "{new_version}"', content)
+    init_file.write_text(content)
+    print(f"Updated version to {new_version} in {init_file}")
+    
+    # 2. Update docs/en/docs/release-notes.md
+    rn_file = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    if not rn_file.exists():
+        print(f"Release notes file not found: {rn_file}")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    lines = rn_file.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
+    
+    # Check if version already exists
+    if any(re.match(rf"^## {re.escape(new_version)}(\s*\(.*\))?$", line) for line in lines):
+        print(f"Version {new_version} already exists in release notes")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    # Find "## Latest Changes" and the first version header
+    latest_changes_idx = -1
+    first_version_idx = -1
+    
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if line.strip() == "## Latest Changes":
+            latest_changes_idx = i
+        if re.match(r"^## \d+\.\d+\.\d+", line):
+            first_version_idx = i
+            break
+            
+    if latest_changes_idx == -1:
+        print("Could not find '## Latest Changes' in release notes")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    if first_version_idx == -1:
+        print("Could not find any existing version header in release notes")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    # Insert "## <version>" after "## Latest Changes"
+    # This moves the content of "Latest Changes" to the new version.
+    lines.insert(latest_changes_idx + 1, f"## {new_version}\n\n")
+    rn_file.write_text("".join(lines))
+    print(f"Added version header {new_version} to {rn_file}")
+    
+    # 3. Run scripts/add_latest_release_date.py
+    # We use sys.executable to ensure we use the same python interpreter
+    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        print(f"Error running add_latest_release_date.py: {result.stderr}")
+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+    print(result.stdout.strip())
+    print("Updated release date in release notes")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
